items.title: Screen asks the user to acknowledge a warning it never shows
items.problem: The review-warning screen renders only a heading and a corrections list; the warning's own title and detail are never displayed, so the user is asked to acknowledge invisible content.
items.acceptance: The screen renders the warning title and a one-line description above the corrections; a screenshot shows the text and the acknowledge action still works.

items.title: Primary action sits below the 56 dp token
items.problem: The form's Apply button renders at 40 dp while the rest of the app uses a 56 dp primary height, so the main action is a smaller target than elsewhere.
items.acceptance: Apply is at least 56 dp tall; a screenshot or a rendered-height assertion shows it.
